operations.name: report.fee.run
operations.purpose: Run a fee and finance report from the catalogue against the fee ledger.

parameters.name: report_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No fee and finance report this reader may run matches — the catalogue offers only what the role permits.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the matching reports from the catalogue.

parameters.notes: The report, from the catalogue's fee and finance group: Daily collection summary; Cash book for the day; Bank reconciliation exceptions; Defaulter list with ageing; Outstanding by class and section; Outstanding by family; Installment plans and missed installments; Invoice register; Receipt register; Reversal, write-off and credit register; Concession and financial aid register; Late fee applied and waived; Withholding tax per family; Student fee ledger; Family statement across siblings; Advance and credit balances held. Only the reports the reader's role permits are offered.

parameters.name: period
parameters.notes: The period the report covers, from and to (BR-2). Set by the reader, never assumed (E3).

parameters.name: class_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No class this reader may see matches.

parameters.notes: Where the report is scoped to a class. A Coordinator is offered only their own classes (BR-3, A2).

parameters.name: section_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No section this reader may see matches.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the matching sections with their class.

parameters.notes: Where the report is scoped to a section. A Coordinator is offered only their own sections (BR-3).

parameters.name: staff_id
parameters.notes: The reader. Every run is recorded against them. Never from the request.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

fields.name: result_id
fields.description: The run. It is taken away with report.export — UC-24-19.

fields.name: parameters
fields.description: The period and scope it ran with, as printed on any output.

fields.name: paged
fields.description: True where the result is paged rather than shown whole.

fields.name: approvers
fields.description: On the reversal, write-off, concession and late-fee reports: the approver named against each entry (BR-5).

fields.name: receipt_gaps
fields.description: On the receipt register: any break in the sequence. The gap is the finding (BR-6).

fields.name: ageing
fields.description: On the defaulter list: 0 to 30, 31 to 60, 61 to 90 and over 90 days — fixed as modelled (OQ-1).

errors.meaning: The reader does not hold the permission for this report.

errors.note: Shown empty and said so, rather than appearing to have failed.

errors.meaning: More rows match than can be shown.
errors.note: Paged, with narrower parameters suggested — never truncated silently.

operations.writesOnRead: The run is recorded — who ran it, which report and over what scope (BR-8).

planningRules.rule: Never assume the period. Ask where the request gives none — the reader sets it before the report runs, and a report run over the wrong period is read as though it were the right one.

Name the approver on every approval report. The reversal, write-off, concession and late-fee reports are read because each entry names who approved it — a report of approvals without that is not a control (BR-5, A1, AC-7).

Report a gap in the receipt register as the finding. The register is sequential and gapless, and a break in it is what the report exists to reveal — investigated where the receipt was recorded (BR-6, A3, AC-8).

Never work out a figure beside the report. Every figure is read from the fee ledger rather than a copy, which is why it can never disagree with a fee screen — a total computed here could (BR-7, AC-11).
Where outstanding is asked for, say whether it is by student or by family. Billing is per household, and both are reported (BR-10).
A Coordinator gets outstanding for their own classes and sections, and nothing wider (BR-3, A2, AC-4).
Never correct anything from a report. It reads and writes nothing; a wrong figure is corrected where it was recorded (BR-9, E7, AC-9).
Report an empty result as an answer, not a failure, and a paged one as paged — suggest a narrower period or scope rather than presenting the first page as the whole.
Say that the run is recorded, and take the report away only through report.export — UC-24-19. There is no route out of its own (BR-8, BR-11).
staff_id and branch_id come from $session. A figure across branches is report.combined.run — the Super Admin's alone.

reversal.statement: A report changes nothing a plan can take back. The record of the run stands (BR-8).

request.text: October ki defaulter list ageing ke saath chahiye
request.gloss: I need October's defaulter list with ageing

resolvedPlans.outcome: The defaulters in their ageing buckets, read from the ledger. Say that the run is recorded, and that it goes out as a file through the export.

resolvedPlans.outcome: The register, with one gap: 004211 to 004213. Say that the gap is the finding, and that it is investigated where the receipts were recorded, not from here.

operations.name: fee.ledger.mine.read
operations.purpose: Return a guardian's own child's fee ledger, or the family statement.

parameters.name: student_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. None of this guardian's children matches (E8).
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the guardian's children with their class.

parameters.notes: One of the guardian's own children. Omitted, the family statement across every sibling under the family code (BR-10, A4).

parameters.name: guardian_id
parameters.notes: The guardian's own portal account. Never from the request — a guardian reads only their own family.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

returns.description: The ledger or the family statement.

fields.name: ledger
fields.description: Invoices, payments, concessions, late fees and adjustments in order, with the running balance — from the ledger itself (BR-7).

fields.name: family_statement
fields.description: Where no child is named: every sibling under the family code and the household total, since billing is per household (BR-10, AC-6).

fields.name: balance
fields.description: What is owed now, as the ledger states it.

errors.meaning: Another family's ledger was asked for.

operations.writesOnRead: The reading is recorded, as every report run is (BR-8, AC-12).

planningRules.rule: Only the guardian's own family. Another family's ledger is never returned, whatever name is given (BR-3, E8, AC-5).
Where no child is named, give the family statement across the siblings — billing is per household (BR-10, A4, AC-6).
Never compute or adjust a balance. It is the ledger's figure, the same one a fee screen shows (BR-7).
A figure the guardian thinks is wrong is corrected by the school where it was recorded — never from here (BR-9).

reversal.statement: A read changes nothing a plan can take back. The record of the reading stands (BR-8).

request.text: hamari family ka fee statement do

resolvedPlans.context: Guardian, three children at Johar Town.
resolvedPlans.outcome: The family statement across all three, with the household total the ledger shows.
